device.name: JVM unit tests on synthetic skeletons

changes.catalogue: 8 -> 12 standing portrait poses: added cross_arms, one_hand_on_hip, side_reach, hand_to_chest; each with two continuous-score conditions and Chinese joint-level hints
changes.overlay_visual_grammar: observed figure -> faint white dashed ghost (1.5dp, alpha .50/.18 ready); target -> 3.5dp amber solid with glow and dark-outlined ring joints; per-target-joint breathing pulse ring when observed/target normalised distance exceeds 0.06 frame units; one-line legend in the hint card
changes.assets: portable pose library (12 templates, CC0, rendered SVG) and composition library (29 patterns, 22 mapped to the on-device rule layer) under assets/

classes: PoseCoachTest T115 additions (8): met + neutral-anti-false-positive per new pose; catalogue sanity 8 -> 12; pose cycling uses catalogue size dynamically
PoseProjectionTest existing everyCataloguePoseProjectsWithAllDrawnJoints automatically covers the four new templates
probe.score_verification: threshold arithmetic independently recomputed outside the app: met samples score 1.0 on both conditions; neutral stance scores 0.00-0.53 per pose (all below the 0.75 ready gate); cross-pose geometric ambiguity (e.g. arms-crossed resembles one-hand-on-hip) is acceptable because the coach evaluates only the user-selected pose, it is not a classifier

new_pose_thresholds_t_units.cross_arms: wrist distance/T 0.50->0.15 ramp; wrist-mid centred on shoulder midline; wrist band at shoulder+0.70T; elbows beyond 1.0-1.6 shoulder-half widths
new_pose_thresholds_t_units.one_hand_on_hip: wrist-to-hip-mid/T 1.0->0.40; elbow 0.9->1.5 shoulder-half; best of either side
new_pose_thresholds_t_units.side_reach: wrist horizontal reach 1.5->2.7 shoulder-half widths; elbow angle 125->160; best side
new_pose_thresholds_t_units.hand_to_chest: wrist-to-chest-point/T 0.60->0.22 (chest at shoulder+0.35T); elbow 0.8->1.4; best side

not_assertable_on_jvm: visual separation readability (dashed ghost vs ringed target on real backgrounds)
pulse cue intuitiveness and 0.06 distance threshold on real bodies
adversarial_review_followups: pulse distance mixes frame-width and frame-height fractions; the Euclidean 0.06 threshold is aspect-ratio dependent and must be re-tuned on device
cross_arms wrist-distance condition cannot distinguish crossed arms from hands clasped together at the chest; a forearm-horizontality condition is a candidate follow-up
single-side poses (one_hand_on_hip, side_reach, hand_to_chest) put no constraint on the unselected arm, by design, matching the earlier one-arm poses
the target ring's dark outline is nearly invisible on the demo card's dark background; amber ring itself stays legible, no functional impact
open: T90 device pass (visual confirmation of both figures, pulse legibility, cadence/thermals), T91 labelled photo set, real-subject threshold calibration
